cells.items: Default UUID user; username identifier by default, swappable user model and configurable identifier; staff/active/superuser; groups and named model permissions. Object-level permission backend is an explicit extension.

Ordered password backend and custom authenticators; inactive policy checked after backend; trusted RemoteUser only behind authenticated allowlisted proxy, never raw client header. Login/Logout/GetUser/UpdateSessionAuthHash.

Versioned Argon2id hashes; legacy PBKDF2/scrypt/bcrypt verifier adapters only when enabled; random salts; constant-time compare; bounded work; minimum length/common/numeric/identifier-similarity/custom validators; unusable password flag.
Login, Logout, PasswordChange/Done, PasswordReset/Done/Confirm/Complete; user creation/change/read-only hash forms; safe next URL; reset anti-enumeration; no automatic public signup route.
Get/Set/Pop/Update/Clear/Flush/CycleKey; expiry age/date/browser-close; modified/accessed flags; clear expired sessions; concurrent writes use version CAS.

PostgreSQL, Redis, cached-DB and signed-cookie explicit choices; signed cookies are readable by holder and have weaker revocation unless identity version checked. File sessions excluded from production target.
Masked per-session token, cookie/header/form transport, Origin/Referer trusted-origin checks, explicit exemption, cookie issuance, token rotation, stable denial response; CORS does not replace CSRF.
CSP enforced/report-only/nonces, frame policy, HSTS, HTTPS redirect, Referrer-Policy, COOP, nosniff; host validation, trusted proxies, CORS allowlist; security headers on error responses too.

Hashed opaque API tokens with scopes/expiry/revocation; pluggable JWT verifier with issuer/audience/algorithm allowlist; HMAC timestamped signing, key ID and bounded fallback rotation; no automatic OAuth provider.
Request principal plus explicit scope predicate at resource boundary; scope applied to IDs, lists, counts, joins, exports, Admin and tasks; database RLS available as defense-in-depth PG policy.

Grouped required config; secure cookies; body/upload/parser limits; injection-safe SQL/templates/headers; rate limits with declared outage policy; safe errors; redacted logging; dependency/security release process.
